description: This file defines an Android Fragment class 'EditorFragment' for a note-taking app, handling note editing, markdown support, attachments, tasks, and UI interactions.

classes.name: EditorFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment for editing notes with markdown, attachments, and task management.

methods.name: setupAttachmentsRecycler
methods.description: Initializes the attachments RecyclerView with its adapter and listener.

methods.name: setupTasksRecycler
methods.description: Initializes the tasks RecyclerView with its adapter and drag-and-drop support.

methods.name: observeData
methods.description: Observes ViewModel data and updates UI accordingly.

methods.name: setupEditTexts
methods.description: Configures title and content EditTexts with listeners and behaviors.

methods.name: setupMarkdown
methods.description: Sets up markdown editing support with a TextWatcher.

methods.name: enableMarkdownTextWatcher
methods.description: Attaches markdown TextWatcher to the content EditText.

methods.name: disableMarkdownTextWatcher
methods.description: Detaches markdown TextWatcher from the content EditText.

methods.name: setupScreenAlwaysOn
methods.description: Enables or disables keeping the screen on.

methods.name: setupToolbar
methods.description: Configures toolbar navigation and back press handling.

methods.name: addTask
methods.description: Adds a new task at specified position.

methods.name: updateTask
methods.description: Updates task content or status, and reorders if needed.

methods.name: showColorChangeDialog
methods.description: Displays a dialog to change note color.

methods.name: showRemindersDialog
methods.description: Displays a dialog with note reminders and options.

methods.name: checkSchedulePermission
methods.description: Checks and requests permission to schedule exact alarms.

methods.name: requestFocusForFields
methods.description: Focuses the content field if empty or forced.

methods.name: updateEditMode
methods.description: Switches between view and edit modes, updating UI visibility.

methods.name: hasNoteEmptyContent
methods.description: Checks if the note content is empty or list is empty.

methods.name: uncheckAllTasks
methods.description: Marks all tasks as not done.

methods.name: removeAllCheckedTasks
methods.description: Removes all tasks marked as done.
